I have enough information to answer the question.

The repository does not use Redis. It relies on an in-memory cache instead. The configuration lives in `store/store.go` inside the `New()` function. A `cache.Config` sets the default TTL to ten minutes. The cache is instantiated in `store/cache/cache.go` as a thread-safe `sync.Map`. User entries are stored via `userCache.Set()`.
